hardware: 4 x H100 80 GB with NVLink; about 885 GiB system RAM

method.common_interval: Last stream first output event to first stream last output event; counts events after the start and through the end, excluding EOS.
method.whole_wave: First request start to last response completion; includes admission, excludes previous cold fills, cache checks, tokenization and request serialization.
method.history_note: Continued current histories; two histories had additional qualification turns before expansion to 30. Image checks used a separate fixture. Replay timings will vary.

chat_completions.method: Full text histories; one Python process with 30 threads; serialization, API tokenization and admission included; cold fill and large artifact writes excluded. Client buffering affects per-stream timestamps. Not a harness benchmark.

limits: These are recorded qualification runs, not new measurements from packaging.
Faster common-interval decoding did not improve every whole-wave result.
Short prose whole-wave speed and cold prefill were slower than the ordinary profile.
Representative retrieval, output and API checks are not a broad model-quality evaluation.
Mixed cold/warm traffic and 30 simultaneous image requests were not benchmarked.
